ownership.landing: Static public-web implementation and route composition only
ownership.brand: Visual identity, voice, semantic token values, and current mark
ownership.ui: Framework-neutral interaction semantics and shared test vectors

browserValidation.accessibility: axe on homepage shell and mobile-navigation open state

updatePolicy: Pin immutable upstream merge revisions; never track branch heads in production evidence.
Do not edit canonical token or mark values locally. Update the pinned brand revision and vendored artifacts together.
Landing-only aliases must describe layout/composition, not redefine brand or status semantics.
UI contract changes must preserve native-first, static-first, non-color state, visible focus, and unsupported-is-not-pass laws.
Run pnpm check and browser validation before accepting a new upstream revision.
